info.title: Petstore
info.summary: A hypothetical pet store service, as it might look in 2026.
info.description:
The Petstore API manages pets, adoptions, smart-collar telemetry, a pet-care assistant, store orders, multipart intake forms, and staff API keys.

It doubles as the oas3-gen reference document: every OpenAPI 3.1.2 feature the generator supports appears here at least once, and the generated client and server are tested against each other.
